title: Competitive Fluorescence Polarization/Anisotropy Binding Assay Experiment Conditions
description: A schema to store experimental conditions for a competitive Fluorescence Polarization (FP) or Fluorescence Anisotropy (FA) binding assay, based on published literature.

pmid.description: The PubMed ID of the publication.

biological_preparation.description: Details about the biological source containing the target protein.

source_type.description: The type of biological material used.

tissue_or_cell_line.description: The tissue, cell line, or expression system used to produce the protein.
examples: E. coli BL21(DE3) expressing His-tagged hBRD4-BD1

species.description: The species origin of the target protein.

target_protein.description: The protein target being studied, including domain or construct boundaries if specified.

protein_concentration.description: The concentration of protein used in the assay, as a number in nanomolar (nM). Convert from other molar units: uM * 1000, pM / 1000, mM * 1000000. Return null if the paper reports mass units (e.g., mg/mL) without a molecular weight for conversion, or if not stated. Use ASCII 'u', not Unicode micro.

protein_purity_method.description: The purification method used, if reported.
examples: Ni-NTA affinity chromatography followed by SEC

fluorescent_tracer.description: Details about the fluorescently labeled probe used in the assay. Analogous to the radioligand in an RBA.

name.description: The name or identifier of the fluorescent tracer, including the fluorophore label.

tracer_type.description: The chemical nature of the tracer.

fluorophore.description: The fluorophore conjugated to the tracer.

excitation_wavelength_nm.description: The excitation wavelength used, in nanometers.

emission_wavelength_nm.description: The emission wavelength used, in nanometers.

concentration_used.description: The concentration of tracer used in the assay, as a number in nanomolar (nM). Convert from other molar units: uM * 1000, pM / 1000. Return null if only qualitative (e.g., '~Kd concentration') or if not stated. Use ASCII 'u', not Unicode micro.

kd_value.description: The known dissociation constant (Kd) of the tracer for the target protein, required for Ki calculation via Cheng-Prusoff.

value.description: Kd as a number in nanomolar (nM). Convert from other molar units: uM * 1000, pM / 1000. Use ASCII 'u', not Unicode micro.

source.description: Whether the tracer Kd was determined in-house or taken from literature.

test_compound.description: Details about the unlabeled competitor compound(s) being evaluated.

description.description: A general description of the test compound(s).

concentration_range.description: The range of concentrations tested for the competition curve, as a string with all concentrations normalized to micromolar (uM). Convert from other molar units: mM * 1000, nM / 1000, pM / 1000000. Use ASCII 'u', not Unicode micro.

vehicle_solvent.description: The solvent used to dissolve the test compounds and its final assay concentration.

dmso_tolerance_tested.description: Whether the authors verified that the final DMSO concentration does not interfere with FP signal or protein-tracer binding.

assay_controls.description: How the assay window (fully bound and fully displaced signals) was defined. Analogous to NSB definition in RBA.

high_signal_control.description: The condition representing maximum polarization/anisotropy (fully bound tracer).

low_signal_control.description: The condition representing minimum polarization/anisotropy (fully displaced or free tracer).

positive_control_compound.description: A reference compound of known affinity used to validate the assay.

positive_control_expected_value.description: The expected Ki or IC50 for the positive control compound, including units.

z_prime_reported.description: Whether the Z'-factor (assay quality metric) was reported and its value.

value.description: The Z'-factor value, if reported. Null otherwise.

buffer_composition.description: The full composition of the assay buffer, including salts and additives. Exclude pH here; use the separate pH field.
examples: 50 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.01% Triton X-100, 1 mM DTT
100 mM phosphate buffer, 100 mM NaCl, 0.05% CHAPS
PBS with 0.01% Tween-20 and 0.1 mg/mL BSA

ph.description: The pH of the assay buffer.

detergent_used.description: Whether a detergent was included to reduce compound aggregation or nonspecific binding, and which one.

incubation_temperature.description: The temperature during incubation. Use a string to allow for 'room temperature'.

incubation_time.description: The duration of incubation before reading, as a number in minutes. Convert from other units: h * 60. Use a string for ranges (e.g., '30-60') or qualitative values (e.g., 'overnight').

equilibrium_confirmed.description: Whether the authors confirmed that binding had reached equilibrium (e.g., via a time course of FP signal).

total_assay_volume.description: The total volume of the assay mixture per well, as a number in microliters (uL). Convert from other units: mL * 1000. Use ASCII 'u', not Unicode micro.

order_of_addition.description: The order in which components were added and any pre-incubation steps.
examples: Protein + compound pre-incubated 15 min, then tracer added

detection.description: How fluorescence polarization or anisotropy was measured. FP/FA is a homogeneous assay with no separation step.

readout_mode.description: Whether the assay reports fluorescence polarization or fluorescence anisotropy.

readout_unit.description: The unit used for the raw readout values.

instrument.description: The plate reader used to measure FP/FA.

g_factor_correction.description: Whether the instrument G-factor was determined and applied to correct for optical bias between detection channels.

assay_window.description: The dynamic range of the assay, i.e. the difference in mP or anisotropy between fully bound and free tracer.

bound_signal.description: The FP/FA value for the fully bound tracer (high control).

free_signal.description: The FP/FA value for the free tracer (low control).

delta.description: The difference between bound and free signal.

data_analysis.description: Details about how the raw data was processed and modeled.

endpoint_reported.description: The primary binding parameter reported in the publication.

ic50_to_ki_conversion.description: The method used to convert IC50 to Ki, if applicable. For FP/FA competition assays, Cheng-Prusoff requires the tracer Kd and tracer concentration.

fitting_model.description: The model used to fit competition curves.
enum: Three-parameter logistic (3PL, Hill slope fixed to 1)

hill_slope_reported.description: Whether a Hill slope (nH) was reported and its value, if available. nH ≠ 1 may indicate compound aggregation, cooperativity, or assay interference.

value.description: The Hill slope value if reported as variable. Null if fixed or not reported.

data_normalization.description: How raw FP/FA data was normalized before curve fitting.

software.description: The software used for curve fitting and data analysis.

replicates.description: The number of replicates and independent experiments.

technical_replicates.description: Number of replicates per concentration within a single experiment.

independent_experiments.description: Number of independent experiments (n). Use a string to capture ranges.

artifact_controls.description: Controls and checks for common FP/FA artifacts that can produce false positives or inaccurate affinities.

compound_fluorescence_interference.description: Whether the authors checked for intrinsic fluorescence of test compounds at the assay wavelengths, which can artifactually alter FP/FA readings.

compound_aggregation_check.description: Whether compound aggregation was assessed (e.g., dynamic light scattering, detergent sensitivity, Hill slope analysis).

inner_filter_effect.description: Whether the authors checked for inner filter effect (absorption of excitation or emission light by the test compound at high concentrations), which can cause apparent FP changes unrelated to binding.

orthogonal_assay_confirmation.description: Whether hits were confirmed by an orthogonal (non-FP) binding assay.
